claim_text: On its Form 990 for the fiscal period ending September 30, 2021, Partners In Nutrition reported total revenue of $140,746,408 and total expenses of $130,432,328. This is PIN-reported volume, not a Feeding Our Future loss figure, and must not be added to FOF charged amounts.

supporting_passages.quote: Gross receipts $140,746,408 ... Total revenue Current Year 140,746,408

amounts.methodology: Form 990 Part I line 12 as filed by Partners In Nutrition. Not alleged_loss and not FOF program_spend.
